scope: Retrospective reanalysis of the frozen sixth-edition simulated counts; no physical measurements, samples or confidence events added. Invalid calibration control remains invalid.

source_costs.qualification: Record and readout matched comparison, with unequal declared evolution times. No calibrated joule advantage; unmeasured overhead is not zero.
unmeasured: hardware verification of same-state same-channel twin contract

support.equality_example: Mean-zero reversible one-mode detector with decay x=s; fair state-independent detector also attains equality

confidence_region.interpretation: coverage conditional on declared record means; calibration-region failure must be added separately

old_certificate.interpretation: Lag0 contributes finite-data variance and detector operations; its Q-versus-additive-reversible divergence is exactly zero only under the common ideal twin contract. Entropy interpretation requires the ordinary stationary Markov thermodynamic assumptions.

bridge.interpretation: The interval encloses the nonlinear lower-bound formula, not the actual entropy production rate. Statistical coverage and physical model assumptions are inherited from the supplied gap.
